title: Private role shadowing from SAML attribute canonicalization + KMS wrap latency causing audit stall
creator: Avery Chen
description: Summary: Several customers running Private clusters reported intermittent authorization failures where users briefly lost RBAC permissions after SSO login. Simultaneously, audit logs for affected sessions showed missing or delayed KMS envelope events leading to audit gaps. Investigation shows two related issues: (1) a SAML attribute canonicalization mismatch that duplicates role claims under different attribute name variants, causing our RBAC role-resolution to pick a stale/less-permissive shadowed role; (2) an edge latency in the async KMS wrap/unwrap background worker that batches final envelope writes under load, which can time out and drop the audit event during high throughput rewraps. Both combine to create short windows where users are effectively deauthorized and no audit evidence is recorded. This ticket coordinates the urgent patch, customer mitigation steps, and post-incident hardening.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SAML canonicalization code path de-duplicates role claims deterministically (case-normalize + agreed attribute priority list). 2) KMS rewrap worker guarantees write-before-ack semantics for audit events: implement synchronous fallback on single-envelope timeout. 3) End-to-end repro no longer produces role shadowing or missing audit entries under synthetic high-load test. 4) Patch rolled to Canary private clusters and 2 impacted customers with zero regressions for session latency.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure Private cluster with IdP that emits both 'roles' and 'memberOf' attributes (different casing and prefix variants). 2) Create RBAC rules that match one variant. 3) Simulate concurrent SSO logins at 200 RPS for 2 minutes while triggering rewraps via frequent key rotations. 4) Observe intermittent access denial events and missing KMS envelope audit items in control plane logs.
root_cause_summary:
- SAML attribute canonicalization: our attribute normalization pipeline accepted multiple raw claim keys and appended them to the claim set without deterministic canonical priority, producing duplicate role entries. RBAC resolution used first-match but ordering could be non-deterministic under certain parsing paths.
- KMS wrap latency: the async rewrap worker batches envelope finalization and defers audit writes. Under high concurrency, a flush timer could be exceeded and code path would drop the event rather than block the critical path, resulting in missing audit events. These two issues interact to create short windows of authorization inconsistency with no audit trail.
mitigation_hotpatch: 1) Immediate customer mitigation: advise affected customers to enable 'strict-attr-priority' in config (server-side feature flag) which forces deterministic attribute priority; provide rollout commands and assist ops. 2) Deploy hotpatch to private control plane YAML: modify canonicalizer to normalize to lowercase, strip common prefixes, and collapse duplicates (non-breaking). 3) Add synchronous fallback in KMS rewrap worker: on timeout (200ms), perform immediate single-envelope write and retry once before dropping. 4) Enable aggressive retry logging to surface any remaining drops for 48h.
rollout_plan: Phase A (Canary - 1 control plane): apply hotpatch to canary private cluster during low traffic window (scheduled 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC). Monitor auth success rate and audit write rate for 2 hours. Phase B (Targeted customers): coordinate maintenance windows with two impacted customers, apply hotpatch and validate. Phase C (Wider rollout): Gradually roll to remaining private clusters with automated canary metrics gating. Rollback plan: revert feature flag and restore prior worker behavior if user-facing latency increases >10% or error rate spikes.
test_plan: - Unit tests: add deterministic attribute normalization tests and RBAC resolution deterministic ordering tests. - Integration: synthetic IdP test with attribute variants and high concurrency SSO simulator. - Load: stress KMS rewrap worker with 500 concurrent rewrap requests and assert no dropped audit writes. - Canary verification: run existing smoke suite plus targeted assertion checks for 1h post-deploy.
monitoring_signals: - Metric: auth.success_rate (per-customer, per-cluster) - alert if <99.5% for 5m. - Metric: audit.kms_envelope_writes and audit.kms_write_failures - alert if failure count >0 in canary. - Log: increase sampling for SSO canonicalizer warnings. - Dashboard: session-auth-latency and role-resolution-disagrees.
comms: - Send urgent note to affected customers with steps to opt-in to 'strict-attr-priority' and proposed maintenance window. - Postmortem to be published within 72h after full rollback/rollout. - Internal all-hands summary on incident channel with mitigation steps and timeline. - Update private tenant runbooks to document 'SAML attribute variants' checklist.
